tau_w_estimate_s.latency_allowance_source: run maximum of 8 observed response latencies (not a bound)
tau_w_estimate_s.interval_semantics: intersection over trials of [passing gap - r_last - G - t_det, trip evidence + L] (rejection/fault) or [onset - r_last - thr / v_min - fp - L, onset] (drift), r_last = the observed response latency of the last streamed command of that trial (its own transaction), L = the latency allowance for the transactions that drew no response; contains tau_w under the listed assumptions
assumptions: the implementation evaluates its stop policy at least once per feedback period (G = 10.0 ms)
the timeout is deterministic (one value tau_w)
one-way transport latencies do not exceed L = 9.7 ms, the run maximum of the observed response latencies (a sample maximum, not a bound; supply --latency-bound-s for a justified bound)

result.decision_basis: source age of the applied setpoint at least 380 ms > required period 20 ms (eq. 9 with the age; setpoint_cp channel, 48 of 100 commands applied) while the client sustained 100 Hz with send gaps <= 10 ms; conditional: the age is measured at the probe's receipt of the channel sample; the verdict assumes the one-way transport delay of setpoint_cp is below the margin of 359.7 ms (supply --latency-bound-s for an unconditional verdict)
